events.summary: Magic 2012 changes the planeswalker lineup: Gideon and Sorin replace Ajani and Liliana, while Jace, Chandra and Garruk return in new versions.
events.quote: Instead of Ajani and Liliana, we see Gideon and Sorin.

events.summary: The columnist promises Liliana will return to the spotlight in the near future.
events.quote: She will definitely find her way to the spotlight in the near future.
